cards.name: Bellossom
cards.description: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.description: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective colors make it invisible.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.description: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to Shellder’s seeping poison.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: When Vaporeon’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It flies straight at its target’s face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: Wherever Grimer has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It hangs and waits for flying insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: A sweet sap leaks from its tail’s tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
